The law states that we can store cookies on your device if they are strictly necessary for the operation of this site. For all other types of cookies we need your permission.

This site uses different types of cookies. Some cookies are placed by third party services that appear on our pages.

You can at any time change or withdraw your consent from the Cookie Declaration on our website.

Two Robotics Leaders.
One Vision for the Future. 

Wandercraft and Ekso Bionics have joined forces to advance robotic mobility, expand access worldwide, and accelerate growth in medical robotics.  

Read the announcement:  

Wandercraft Acquires Ekso Bionics, Uniting Two Pioneers to Advance and Expand Robotic Mobility [Press Release]

Frequently Asked Questions

Learn More

Regain mobility with Ekso Bionics

Whether you are an individual living with spinal cord injury (SCI), a physical therapist working with patients after stroke, brain injury, SCI, or those with multiple sclerosis (MS), or a physician seeking better options to enhance your patients' mobility, Ekso Bionics has leading exoskeleton technology that can benefit those working through their rehabilitation or those living with SCI who want to walk again.

Home & Community Use

Individuals living with spinal cord injury levels T3 to L5 can now walk in an exoskeleton at home and in their communities with Ekso Indego Personal. Insurance coverage now possible!

Clinical Use

Individuals post stroke, acquired brain injury, spinal cord injury, and those with MS may improve more quickly using our rehabilitation exoskeletons as part of their rehab journey.

Find A Center

More than 500+ rehabilitation centers worldwide. Find the nearest facility offering Ekso Bionics technology.

INSURANCE

Medicare for Ekso Indego Personal

Medicare may cover an exoskeleton when it is considered reasonable and necessary based on a patient’s medical condition and clinical documentation.

Am I Eligible?

From hospital to home

Individuals with neurological impairments and SCI can utilize our exoskeletons in their journey to independence.

EksoNR is the only FDA cleared exoskeleton for brain injury and MS and was the first exoskeleton to be cleared for both stroke and SCI. Designed to support patients throughout their rehabilitation journey, EksoNR helps them progress toward independent mobility and a confident return to everyday activities.

Ekso Indego Personal is the lightest weight exoskeleton available and enables individuals paralyzed from SCI (level T3-L5) to stand and walk at home and in their community. This modular exoskeleton allows individuals to stand, walk, have eye-level conversations, and hug their loved ones heart-to-heart out of their wheelchair.
